ui.agents.detail.origin.shipped_with_app.role: Agent origin section description for a built-in agent
ui.agents.detail.origin.shipped_with_app.tone: Plain, factual sentence with full stop
ui.agents.detail.origin.shipped_with_app.length: One short sentence in the detail pane; may wrap on narrow panes
ui.agents.detail.origin.shipped_with_app.note: No placeholders. Says the definition came bundled with the application itself, as opposed to being created by the user or installed from a starter. Sibling of installed_starter and created_locally in the same slot.

ui.agents.detail.origin.installed_starte.role: Agent origin section description for an agent installed from a packaged starter
ui.agents.detail.origin.installed_starte.tone: Plain, factual sentence with full stop
ui.agents.detail.origin.installed_starte.length: One short sentence in the detail pane; may wrap on narrow panes
ui.agents.detail.origin.installed_starte.note: No placeholders. Says the agent was copied from a starter that ships with the app, and may since have been edited (a changed-fields list can follow). 'Starter' is the product's word for a packaged template agent; keep it consistent with the starters catalogue.

ui.agents.detail.origin.compare_packaged.role: Disclosure summary (toggle label) that expands a read-only view of the original packaged instructions
ui.agents.detail.origin.compare_packaged.tone: Plain, action-oriented noun phrase; no full stop
ui.agents.detail.origin.compare_packaged.length: One short line; sits on a collapsed disclosure row
ui.agents.detail.origin.compare_packaged.note: No placeholders. Only shown when the installed copy's instructions differ from the packaged original; the expanded block shows the packaged text for comparison with the current instructions.
